title: WF03 ADP04/IDN02 blocker: duplicate group-member idempotency path returned internal_error on fallback read
summary: Resolved TC-IDN-02-03 by fixing the duplicate-membership fallback query in src/identity/registry.zig. The fallback now uses explicit tenant-scoped joins for groups/users, preserving ADP-04 tenant-bound behavior while returning a stable existing membership record for idempotent duplicate add-member requests.

root_cause.details: Registry.addGroupMember inserts with tenant-scoped predicates, but when ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING occurred it executed a fallback read that did not enforce tenant joins and used a fragile placeholder pattern. On the duplicate path this surfaced as RegistryError.PersistenceFailed, which bubbled through service/routes to HTTP 500 internal_error instead of idempotent 200 with created=false.

changes: Updated the fallback SELECT after ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING in Registry.addGroupMember to read from group_members gm with explicit JOIN groups and JOIN users.
Enforced g.tenant_id = $1::uuid and u.tenant_id = $1::uuid in the fallback query so duplicate resolution is tenant-bound and ADP-04 isolation-safe.

prevention: Keep duplicate-handling fallback queries symmetry-matched with insert predicates, including tenant constraints, to prevent idempotency paths from diverging from mainline behavior.
Avoid placeholder numbering that leaves unused parameters in SQL; use contiguous placeholders or explicit usage for every bound argument in repository queries.
When adapting identity schema/tenant behavior, rerun IDN-02 duplicate add-member integration coverage alongside ADP-04 tenant isolation checks.
